checked_artifacts.rationale: Read-only charter already governs the accepted GPL-3.0-only compatibility, excluded reference-corpus, architecture, security, durability, and documentation boundaries.
Repository contract and fixture guidance already matches accepted producer behavior while reserving Frozen promotion for WP12.
Accepted HTTP health behavior, canonical response envelopes, and public-access metadata conform to this Draft OpenAPI example.
Accepted Zig and TypeScript wire values preserve the schema's identifiers, int64 money, dates, instants, digests, and request IDs.
Accepted contract tooling enforces the documented lifecycle, ownership, immutable-pin, output, and fixture constraints.
Accepted composition tooling enforces owner event identities, payload bindings, and collision rejection represented by this schema.
Accepted validators and synthetic fixtures preserve the immutable envelope fields and extensible data object represented by this schema.
The authoritative receipt schema remains consistent with the closed inventory, topology, command, and disposition rules used by this attestation.
Accepted migration discovery and validation enforce owner-scoped IDs, exact dependencies, paths, and script and descriptor digests represented by this schema.
Accepted module discovery and route-policy composition enforce owner paths, mount keys, catalogs, migration roots, and protected-default access.
The repository Draft manifest and canonical fixture paths already match accepted contract tooling and producer outputs.
Persistence State, DurableReceipt, StoreError, and Diagnostic shapes already match accepted storage behavior.
The plan already records the GPL-3.0-only policy, exact ShovelerDB engine pin and source-tree digest, and producer-versus-closure evidence boundary.
The quickstart already names the accepted ShovelerDB revision, GPL-3.0-only engine export paths and exclusions, producer commands, and WP12 closure boundary.
Research already aligns the ShovelerDB decision and license analysis with the accepted GPL-3.0-only engine pin and excluded GPL-2.0-only reference material.
Research evidence entries remain consistent with accepted dependency, contract, persistence, HTTP, and toolchain decisions.
All four public ShovelerDB evidence URLs already use the accepted immutable GPL-3.0-only engine revision.
Amended GPL-3.0-only requirements, negative license policy, exact ShovelerDB pin, acceptance scenarios, and the WP12 closure boundary already match accepted behavior.
